entries.text: There you are! You took your time![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0480_sister_01

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]You really battled great yesterday,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0480_sister_02

entries.text: I guess the Mask Retrieval Squad has completed\nits mission.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0480_sister_03

entries.text: Though Kiki...\c\nWell, he’s shut himself in his room ever since he\ngot home yesterday.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0480_sister_04

entries.text: That’s worrying...
entries.label: sdc01_0480_select_01

entries.text: He won’t come out?
entries.label: sdc01_0480_select_02

entries.text:
Oh, but you don’t need to feel guilty or anything,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)].\c
It all started ’cause I said we should keep the
whole Ogerpon thing a secret...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0480_sister_06

entries.text: And you wouldn’t think it, but...Kiki’s got a bit\nof an ego too! He doesn’t take losing well.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0480_sister_07

entries.text: Anyway, how’s Ogerpon doing?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0480_sister_08

entries.text: I’ll be honest, I’ve grown real fond of Ogerpon\nmyself! Guess Kiki’s rubbed off on me a bit.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0480_sister_09

entries.text: Do you think you could let me have a battle\nwith Ogerpon?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0480_sister_10

entries.text: You’re not still angry about me giving you a\nhard time when you first got here, are you?\r\nC’mon, I just wanna make some memories![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0480_sister_11

entries.text: I knew you’d say yes! You’re not one to turn down\na good battle. Let me know when you’re ready![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0480_sister_12

entries.text: I see you’ve got Ogerpon on your team! I think\nits battle style changes depending on its mask,\r\nso is it all set and ready to go?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0480_sister_29

entries.text: Hey, you gotta have Ogerpon on your team!\nTalk to me once you’ve got it, OK?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0480_sister_30

entries.text: Ogerpon isn’t in your team OR in your Boxes?\nOh well... Do you still wanna battle?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0480_sister_31

entries.text: Come talk to me when you’re ready to say yes.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0480_sister_32

entries.text: Right. Let’s get to our positions.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0480_sister_13

entries.text: Aaagh, I lost! But I’m also not surprised![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0480_sister_14

entries.text: You and Ogerpon really do get along, don’t you?\nIt’s almost making me jealous.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0480_sister_15

entries.text: I wanted to see what Ogerpon could do in battle,\nbut oh well...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0480_sister_33

entries.text: Pon pon!
entries.label: sdc01_0480_ogre_01

entries.text: I actually, uh...\c\nSheesh, this is awkward to tell you, but I—[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0480_sister_16

entries.text: Ro-to-to-to-to... ♪
entries.label: sdc01_0480_system_01

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Hey there, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!\nThis is Briar.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]
entries.label: sdc01_0480_bbteacher_01

entries.text: It seems all student pairs have completed their\norienteering as of this morning.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]
entries.label: sdc01_0480_bbteacher_02

entries.text: The caretaker wanted to have some words, so\ncould you head back to the community center?[VAR 0x0114(0042)]
entries.label: sdc01_0480_bbteacher_03

entries.text: Message received, loud and clear![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0480_sister_25

entries.text: Ah, Carmine is with you? Wonderful, that’s one\nless phone call I have to make.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]
entries.label: sdc01_0480_bbteacher_04

entries.text: You kids never cease to amaze me. It seems you\nbecome fast friends the moment you spend even\r\nthe briefest amount of time together.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]
entries.label: sdc01_0480_bbteacher_05

entries.text: Well, head on over to the community center!\nI’ll be there with the rest of the students.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]
entries.label: sdc01_0480_bbteacher_06

entries.text: She’s right about it being the briefest amount of\ntime. We only just became friends, and now we...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0480_sister_26

entries.text: Oh well. Let’s go see what the nosy old guy wants.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0480_sister_27

entries.text: I don’t really want to, but...I guess I can play nice\none last time.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0480_sister_28
